latest.title: Link to the game
latest.summary: A third way in beside the save folder and the single file: with the Big Copilot Link mod from the Steam Workshop enabled, click Link to the game and the board reads the running game itself. No folder to pick, and the board follows the game as you play: it refreshes on the game hour, after a game save, and whenever you click Update. The mod serves the game's own save to this page on your computer and to nothing else; Chrome and Edge ask once to allow the site to reach it. The local watcher learnt the same trick as --game.
